message: Off-by-one: `len(hits) > self.limit` admits limit + 1 requests per window. With limit=2 a caller gets 3 through. Should be `len(hits) >= self.limit`.
`buckets={}` is a mutable default argument, evaluated once at import, so every RateLimiter in the process shares one bucket dict. Use `buckets=None` and allocate per instance.

`sweep()` deletes from `self.buckets` while iterating `self.buckets.items()`, which raises RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration on the first idle key. Iterate over `list(self.buckets.items())`.
`hits.pop(0)` is O(n); a deque would be tidier, though n is bounded by limit so this is not worth blocking on.
